verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, OpenAI-like endpoints, a headless daemon and the lms CLI. None of it mentions an official client SDK (e.g., a JavaScript or Python library) for building against LM Studio. A REST API or OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
